Act, Harda, District - Harda in SPL SC No.05/2021 convicting the appellant for the offence under Sections 366 and 376 (D) of the IPC and sentencing him to suffer RI for 5 years with fine of Rs.2000/- and RI for 20 years with fine of Rs.1000/- with default stipulations respectively.

entities.text:
Special Judge (POCSO)
Act, Harda, District - Harda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that prosecutrix is major and she is consenting party.
She has falsely implicated the appellant.
There are good chances of success of appeal and appeal is going to take time for its disposal in near future.
There is no criminal history alleged against the appellant.
It is, therefore, prayed that the sentence imposed on the appellant be suspended and he be enlarged on bail.
Learned Dy. Advocate General for the State, on the other hand, opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the 2 CRA-3234-2024 record,
without commenting anything on merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant Durgesh Meena and to release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 20.8.2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed Durgesh Meena vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108523802/
